sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (up to unlimited / >₹3 Cr mentioned)

room_rent.display: As opted – ward/shared/twin/private with per-day limit
room_rent.note: Room rent limit and type are chosen by insured and specified in Policy Schedule. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken. No universal 'no cap' default.

icu.display: Covered – limit as per Policy Schedule
icu.note: ICU covered under Section 1A/1B; specific per-day cap depends on room rent option chosen and stated in Policy Schedule.

copayment.display: Zone-based: 0–20% depending on zone of treatment
copayment.note: Zone C insured treated in Zone A: 20% co-pay; Zone C in Zone B: 10%; Zone B in Zone A: 10%; Zone A anywhere: 0%. No co-pay for accidental injury. OPD section has separate co-pay (25% yr1, 10% yr2, nil yr3+).

sub_limits.display: Several sub-limits: modern treatments capped at 50% SI, cochlear implant 50% SI, hyaluronic acid/intra-articular injections 5% SI; Smart Save adds disease-wise caps if opted
sub_limits.note: Modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, etc.) capped at 50% SI by default (waivable via Section 24 Advance Care add-on). Cochlear implant 50% SI. Hyaluronic acid/intra-articular injections 5% SI. Smart Save (optional) adds sub-limits on cataract, knee replacement, angioplasty, hernia, CABG, hysterectomy, etc.

deductible.display: None (optional aggregate or per-claim deductible available)
deductible.note: Deductible is optional – aggregate or smart deduct (per claim) as opted and stated in Policy Schedule. Default is nil.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses; can be reduced as opted and mentioned in Policy Schedule.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is chosen by insured and specified in Policy Schedule; standard IRDAI definition of 36 months applies as maximum; exact months not fixed in wording. FastTrack add-on reduces PED wait to 30 days for listed conditions.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific disease waiting period (list includes arthritis, cataract, hernia, etc.) is chosen by insured and stated in Policy Schedule; standard cap is 36 months per IRDAI definition.

maternity.display: Optional add-on; waiting period as opted in Policy Schedule
maternity.note: Section 6 Maternity Benefit & New Born Baby Cover is optional. Waiting period chosen at inception and stated in Policy Schedule. Covers delivery, complications, lawful termination; limited to 2 childbirth events. New born covered up to 90 days within maternity SI.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to limit in Policy Schedule (rate and max as opted)
cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus rate per claim-free year and maximum cap are chosen at inception and stated in Policy Schedule. Example in wording shows 10%/yr up to 50%. Reduces on claim in same proportion. Cumulative Bonus Protection Cover (Section 28) available as optional add-on to prevent reduction.

restoration.display: Once or more per year, 100% SI – related or unrelated as opted
restoration.note: Section 12 Sum Insured Refill: 100% SI refilled; number of times per year as per Policy Schedule. Related hospitalization requires 45-day cooling period. Can be opted for related and/or unrelated illness. Optional section.

pre_hosp.display: As opted (days stated in Policy Schedule)
pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for number of days chosen by insured and stated in Policy Schedule. Exact days not fixed in wording.

post_hosp.display: As opted (days stated in Policy Schedule)
post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for number of days chosen by insured and stated in Policy Schedule. Alternatively, Post Hospitalisation Lumpsum Benefit (Section 2) can be opted instead.

day_care.note: Day care procedures under Section 1A and 1B covered for illness and accidental injury respectively under general/local anaesthesia in hospital/day care centre.

domiciliary.note: Section 5 Home (Domiciliary) Hospitalization is an optional cover. Excludes listed conditions (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.). Minimum 3-day treatment required.

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient, NABH/NQAS accredited AYUSH hospitals only)
ayush.note: Section A9 AYUSH Cover under Section 1A. Inpatient treatment only; outpatient and non-curative/preventive treatments excluded. AYUSH hospital must have NABH pre-entry or NQAS state-level certificate.

organ_donor.note: Section 3 Organ Donor is optional. Covers harvesting expenses subject to Section 1A SI availability. Donor pre/post-hospitalisation up to 5% of harvesting claim. Specific waiting period applies.

ambulance.display: Road ambulance covered up to limit in Policy Schedule
ambulance.note: Section A5/B5 Road Ambulance: per-hospitalisation limit stated in Policy Schedule. Emergency only; planned hospitalisation excluded. Air ambulance covered under Section 4 (optional, India only).

modern_treatments.display: Sub-limited to 50% SI by default; upgradeable to 100% SI via Section 24
modern_treatments.note: 12 modern/new-age treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI under Section 1A/1B by default (Exclusion 37). Section 24 Advance Care (optional add-on) removes this cap and covers up to 100% SI.

consumables.note: Section 10 Consumable Cover is optional. Covers non-medical/consumable expenses (per Annexure A) incurred during hospitalisation that are otherwise excluded. Covered up to Section 1A/1B SI.

global_cover.display: Optional – Asia / Worldwide excl. USA & Canada / Worldwide incl. USA & Canada
global_cover.note: Base policy covers India only. Geographical extension to Asia, Worldwide excl. USA & Canada, or Worldwide incl. USA & Canada available on additional premium with additional co-payment and prior approval required.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for all modes except monthly premium payment where it is 15 days. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Free look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability permitted as per IRDAI norms; credits for waiting periods, NCB, moratorium transferable.

notable_exclusions.display: Hazardous/adventure sports (professional), tobacco-related oral/respiratory cancer, predictive genome testing, stem cell transplant (non-bone marrow), artificial life maintenance, external congenital anomaly, defence operations

optional_riders.display: Maternity+Newborn, Infertility, OPD, Consumables, Organ Donor, Air Ambulance, Domiciliary, Critical Illness Benefit/Hospitalisation, Cancer Benefit/Hospitalisation, Daily Hospital Cash, SI Refill, SI Multiplier, Advance Care (modern tx 100%), FastTrack (PED 30-day), Smart Save, Cumulative Bonus Protection, Global Cover
